subject: The 3-minute mistake 90% of users make every morning
preview_text: I discovered this by accident. It’s the secret to turning deadline panic into a finished paper without the all-nighter.
body_paragraphs: I was watching my analytics dashboard last week and noticed something weird. The students who get A’s with this app? They don’t just use it when they’re panicking. They do one tiny thing first, every single day. The ones who don’t? They’re the ones still pulling all-nighters.

It’s not about working harder. It’s about a 3-minute routine. Open the app, go to the ‘Brain Dump’ notepad, and just type every single thought, half-idea, or random quote about your topic. Don’t judge it, don’t edit. Just dump. For 3 minutes. This primes your brain. It tells your subconscious you’re working on the paper, so it starts connecting dots for you in the background. By the time you sit down to actually write, the blank page fear is gone. The ideas are already flowing.

That ‘Brain Dump’ notepad is hidden in the sidebar. Most people skip it because it looks too simple. But that’s the feature that makes the AI 10x smarter for you. It learns from YOUR raw thoughts first, then generates thesis statements and outlines that actually sound like you. It’s the difference between generic AI text and your A-grade paper.

Do this for the next 3 days. Just 3 minutes when you open your laptop in the morning. I promise you’ll shock yourself with how much easier the writing feels. Open Thesis Generator and hit the ‘Brain Dump’ tab now. P.S. The students who do this? They cut their writing time in half. Every time. Their secret is just showing up for 3 minutes.
